verdict.summary: The write budget is correctly applied as a deterministic prefix of the issue-number-sorted classified plan, pacing occurs only between actual writes, and deferred classified issues remain visible both in stdout and the workflow summary. The implementation preserves dry-run and JSON behavior, rejects non-positive budgets, and leaves unclassified residue semantically separate. The focused tests exercise the real main/apply path with only external effects stubbed, covering bounds, pacing, reporting, convergence, argument validation, and cron-derived budget arithmetic. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect was found.
